Shuttle Music decodes audio with FFmpeg n7.1.5 (https://ffmpeg.org), licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License version 2.1 or later. The build enables LGPL components only, with no GPL or non-free parts. FFmpeg is a trademark of Fabrice Bellard.
Source: https://github.com/timusus/Shuttle2/releases/tag/ffmpeg-n7.1.5-source (the unmodified n7.1.5 release and the build script). FFmpeg's n7.1.5 tag (commit 3a0867c2bfda4a4d4309ca1a8cbdc6175e67f587) at https://git.ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg.git, unmodified, built by ios/scripts/build-ffmpeg.sh in https://github.com/timusus/Shuttle2, which lists the configure options.
Relinking: FFmpeg is not linked into the app binary. It ships as four dynamic frameworks in S2.app/Frameworks: libavutil (59), libswresample (5), libavcodec (61) and libavformat (61). To run Shuttle Music with a modified FFmpeg, build the same major versions with the configure options that script lists (it builds any FFmpeg commit you set as FFMPEG_COMMIT in it), replace those frameworks in S2.app/Frameworks and re-sign the app.
